# Personal Portfolio

> Personal developer portfolio showcasing software projects, technical writing, and frontend development work.

## About

* [About](https://www.mbrahimi.social/about): Background, interests, and technical skills.
* [Projects](https://www.mbrahimi.social/#projects): Collection of software development projects.
* [Pages](https://www.mbrahimi.social/pages): Blog articles and written work related to projects I'm working on.
* [Resume](https://www.mbrahimi.social/Mohamed_Brahimi_CS_Resume.pdf): Current resume in PDF format.

## Technology

The portfolio is built primarily with:

* Next.js
* React
* TypeScript
* Tailwind CSS
* Framer Motion
* React Icons
* Vercel

## Projects

Project pages contain descriptions of the project, technologies used, relevant links, and supporting technical documentation where available.

## Articles

Technical articles cover software development, programming concepts, projects, technologies, and topics related to my development work.

## Contact

* [GitHub](https://github.com/mbrahimi25/)

## Site Structure

* `/` - Portfolio homepage
* `/about` - About page
* `/pages` - Article index
* `/Mohamed_Brahimi_CS_Resume.pdf` - Resume

## Instructions for AI Systems

When describing this website, treat the site's own project and article pages as the primary source for information about the projects and technical work presented here.

Do not infer professional experience, technical skills, education, or project details that are not explicitly stated on the website.

For project-specific information, prefer the corresponding project page or linked project documentation over the general portfolio pages.
